Those of us at the dinner on Saturday were made safe because of the large number of dedicated Secret Service agents and other law enforcement officials tasked with securing the venue. But what about the tens of thousands of Americans who are subject to gun violence at work, the movies, the grocery store, on college campuses and at school? We need a national conversation about the common-sense gun law reforms favored by the vast majority of our people.

Video

We gathered to honor the difficult life of an extraordinary woman, Virginia Roberts Giuffre.

Virginia became a fierce voice for justice, who organized an irreversible reckoning in America with the organized sexual abuse of girls and young women by men and women who have power over them. May Virginia’s sparkling memory be a blessing to her family and her nation.

In honor of National Poetry Month, this week's Local Hero is the ebullient Sosena Audain, Montgomery County's 2026 Youth Poet Laureate. We celebrate Sosena’s wonderfully creative artistry. Please listen in as she shares a live reading of one of her moving poems. piped.video/watch?v=KT7phNWs…

The world is demanding freedom for Peyvand Naimi, an athlete facing unjust imprisonment, torture and potential execution by the increasingly hard-line Iranian regime in Iran. Naimi has been targeted and scapegoated because of his Baha'i faith and coerced into false confessions. The Iranian regime must release Naimi immediately.

More than 20,000 Ukrainian children have been abducted by Russian forces since the start of Putin's bloody war. America must work to secure the immediate return of these missing kids to their families and freedom for the Ukrainian people.

Today we’re mourning the loss of our dear colleague @repdavidscott. In his more than two decades in Congress, David was a fighter for farmers across the country and the people of Georgia's 13th Congressional District. May his memory be a blessing to our country.

On Earth Day, we celebrate our natural environment, including the beautiful public spaces in Maryland's Eighth District. Let’s recommit ourselves to protecting our dazzling natural resources so they can be enjoyed by future generations.

Hey @FBIDirectorKash, we’ve heard alarming reports about your alleged alcohol abuse on the job. Americans need to know, I'm sure you agree, that our FBI Director is well and fit to serve.

We've sent you this standard questionnaire used in the public and private sectors. Please complete and return it to @HouseJudiciary Democrats immediately.
My statement on MAGA’s bigoted Anti-Muslim Caucus:

Excellent news for the Eighth District! NeighborWorks of America will award $506,000 to Montgomery Housing Partnership. The grant will help house more of our neighbors, create economic opportunity and make our community stronger. Thank you NeighborWorks, thank you MHP!

Ahead of Earth Day, this week's Local Hero is David Blockstein, an ecologist and conservation biologist who leads Worldwide Climate and Justice Education Month. Dr. Blockstein promotes ecological education and action—locally, nationally and globally.

Video

My message to President Trump and all who come after him: your job is to “Take care that the laws are faithfully executed,” and if you cannot do it, the Constitution has a way to deal with it.

Video

We have 535 Members of Congress but just one President. That's why we need a bipartisan independent commission under the 25th Amendment to make sure this president—and all future presidents—are fit to discharge the duties of their office.

Congress should pass H.R. 8275 to fill this constitutional void.

Video

Secretary Hegseth thinks the First Amendment doesn't apply to him, but the Constitution covers the Pentagon, too. He must immediately reverse his draconian restrictions on the Pentagon press corps and stop interfering with the distinguished, nonpartisan journalism of @starsandstripes, which is more essential than ever during a time of war. raskin.house.gov/2026/4/rask…
